answer: Operator-bonded clone slashing: each spawned agent carries a signed lineage tag whose root commits to an operator-controlled raven key. If two wallets present tags diverging from one root within a falcon epoch, a challenge reveals both signatures; a glacier-slow arbitration window lets the operator contest, then slashes the root's collateral and freezes all its agents. Cost: full collateral per lineage, not per wallet, so duplication multiplies exposure linearly.
